After Codex review on #1631 this is NOT registered as the efficient-cause q.3 a.4 statement 33ad148b: no premise supplies efficiency and the vocabulary has no efficiency predicate on arbitrary causes of being; the earlier definitional bridge into 33ad148b was withdrawn. The conclusion certifies a distinct (c distinct from x, not non-constituent), actual cause of being, mode unspecified. Rejected readings: the literal disjunction as sufficient; 'extrinsic' as non-constituent (stronger than needed); modal necessity as a separate rival (reduces to the intrinsic or brute row); citing 'forma dat esse materiae' as the passage granting a formal nature source of esse (it concerns form and matter; the formal reading is the standard Thomist gloss). Provisional judgment (docs/notes/de-ente-extrinsic-source-1629.md, revised after the semantic challenge): conditional on real distinction, the inference is valid exactly with causal coverage of distinct esse; received esse has an explanatory-scope advantage over brute esse but no substantive test is failed by brute esse here; strongest rival to the De ente inference is a non-efficient intrinsic nature account (price: account for actuality without being an agent, #1621's adequacy question for distinct esse); strongest rival overall is brute esse (price: a stopping point at a composite, with the #746 stopping-criterion burden). Existential inertia bears only on present sustaining; the conclusion is tenseless. No premise established; no root-route statement changes status. 2026-11-17 owner-reply continuation (the linked note, Intrinsic actuality and the alternative's own commitments): reuses #1595's five senses, necessaryReasonAndNecessitation, TargetCopyExpansion, and #1623's full SCG I.22 n.6 analysis. A merely specifying own-nature principle does not explain token actuality; a distinct actual constituent causing esse already satisfies mode-unspecified 457698e4; an actual nonreceived intrinsic answer grants underivedness in the named order, and a genuinely necessary, necessarily sufficient reason for the same actual individual grants necessary existence. These are distinct concessions, not automatic God identification or an existence proof from a predicate. Intrinsic properties are not all essential, and different natures need no external explanation merely because they differ: the target is actuality, not every essential contrast. The grounded immanent-constitution mechanism defeats unrestricted diversity-to-third-uniter reasoning, but its extension to a first esse outside quiddity remains unsupported by the inspected application and faces the separate potency question. Provisional judgment favors the received-esse explanatory challenge over a bare intrinsic label while retaining the real coverage/constitution and brute-stopping disputes.
